scope: same-assistant fresh proof review and synthetic targeted checks, not independent review or natural evidence
closure_scope: all finite intersection-closed families containing the ground set on n=1,2,3,4; classify unique generation independently by inclusion-minimal generators; test whether sensitive coordinates alone determine closure at every source set
generic_policy: on uniquely generated closures, query an unknown extreme coordinate of the current possible upper set; stop when closures of known positive and possible sets coincide; query only singleton source bits
dag_scope: 60 fixed-seed public DAG role configurations on n=5..8, at most 5 unknown edges and 5 deletable edges, h<=2; all compatible source subsets; reverse vertex labels; independent BFS failure replay
maintenance_attack: legal deletion consumes budget, canonical residual coarsening drops a persistent support used by a transported path receipt; distinguish native sufficiency from validity against the new physical support
metrics: classification equivalence, exact query-set equality, transcript sufficiency, least native output, receipt checking, transported-receipt failure under support coarsening; no wall-time or novelty win
stop: complete this bounded audit once; retain any counterexample and report scope; do not access sealed evaluation units or call models
